## Preparing the work space
### Setting up the working directory
```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
require("knitr")
opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/Scratch_MF/sc_Mm/analysis/COL3351A5/")
options(bitmapType = "cairo")
```
### Loading required packages and scripts
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(Matrix)
library(R.utils)
library(reshape2)
library(gridExtra)
library("limma")
library(stringr)
```
### Loading previously created Seurat object
```{r}
COL3351A5 <- readRDS(file = "Data/COL3351A5_filt_norm_cl_DPv2.0.rds")
```
### Visualizing the UMAP
```{r}
Idents(object = COL3351A5) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.6"
COL3351A5_umap_r0.5 <- DimPlot(COL3351A5, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, label.size = 3.5) + theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
COL3351A5_umap_r0.5
COL3351A5_umap_r0.5_NL <- DimPlot(COL3351A5, reduction = "umap", label = F) + theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
COL3351A5_umap_r0.5_NL
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/COL3351A5_UMAP_Label_DPv2.0.pdf", plot = COL3351A5_umap_r0.5, width = 10, height = 7)
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/COL3351A5_UMAP_NoLabel_DPv2.0.pdf", plot = COL3351A5_umap_r0.5_NL, width = 10, height = 7)
```
### Let's now view the number of doublets per cluster, percentage-wise
```{r}
df_num <- FetchData(COL3351A5, vars = c("ident", "DF.classifications_0.05")) %>%
        dplyr::count(ident, DF.classifications_0.05) %>%
        tidyr::spread(ident, n)
rownames(df_num) <- df_num[,1]
df_num <- df_num[,-1]
tot <- colSums(df_num, na.rm = T)
metric_df <- as.data.frame(apply(X = df_num, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(X){
  X / tot * 100
}))
## Sanity Check
rowSums(metric_df, na.rm = T)
```
### Inspecting the output
```{r}
metric_df
na.omit(metric_df[metric_df$Doublet >= 40,]) # clusters that have more than 40% doublets as give by df
```
## Visualizing expression of doublets and "nones"
```{r}
DimPlot(COL3351A5, reduction = "umap", label = F, group.by = "percent.class")
DimPlot(COL3351A5, reduction = "umap", label = F, group.by = "DF.classifications_0.05") # 5%
DimPlot(COL3351A5, reduction = "umap", label = F, group.by = "DF.classifications_0.1") # 10%
COL3351A5_umap_r0.5
```
### Let's now view these numbers per cluster, percentage-wise
```{r}
perc.class_num <- FetchData(COL3351A5, vars = c("ident", "percent.class")) %>%
        dplyr::count(ident, percent.class) %>%
        tidyr::spread(ident, n)
rownames(perc.class_num) <- perc.class_num[,1]
perc.class_num <- perc.class_num[,-1]
tot <- colSums(perc.class_num, na.rm = T)
metric_class <- as.data.frame(apply(X = perc.class_num, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(X){
  X / tot * 100
}))
## Sanity Check
rowSums(metric_class, na.rm = T)
```
### Inspecting the output
```{r}
metric_class
```
### Loading Y-linked genes
```{r}
rat_y <- readRDS(file = "/camp/home/falism/Scratch_MF/ReferenceLists_SourceFiles/YGenes/Mm_yGenes_PCG_Ensembl104.rds")

#Transforming the ensembl IDs into ensembl-symbol hybrids used in the dataset
y_genes <- c()
for (i in 1:length(rat_y)) {
  y_genes <- append(x = y_genes, values = grep(rat_y[i], rownames(COL3351A5[["RNA"]]), value = T))
}
```
### Investigating expression of sex-dependent markers
```{r}
FeaturePlot(object = COL3351A5, features = c("ENSMUSG00000086503-Xist", y_genes), combine = F, label = T)
VlnPlot(COL3351A5, features = c("ENSMUSG00000086503-Xist", y_genes), combine = F)
DotPlot(object = COL3351A5, features =  c("ENSMUSG00000086503-Xist", y_genes), dot.scale = 2) + RotatedAxis() + theme(plot.title = element_text(size=10), axis.title = element_text(size=10), axis.text = element_text(size=7))
```
### Investigating the patterns of potentially confounding variables (**percent.mt**, **percent.rr**, **nFeature_MmA**, **nCounts_MmA**). The percentage of mito/rsp is just a metric - there is no information stored in the gene matrix, only a number. 
```{r}
FeaturePlot(COL3351A5, features = c("percent.mt", "percent.rr", "nFeature_MmA", "nCount_MmA"), combine = F, label = T)
VlnPlot(COL3351A5, features = c("percent.mt", "percent.rr", "nFeature_MmA", "nCount_MmA"), combine = F)
```

## Adding labels. There are several populations of suspicious cells that could be further scrutinized, but for now, let's keep them in the dataset. 
```{r}
newIDs <- c("DSC1", "DSC2", "Endothelial1", "DSC3", "DSC4", "Macrophages", "DSC5", "uNK", "DSC6", "Endothelial2", "DSC7", "Endothelial3", "DSC8 (prol.)", "DSC/Troph?", "Doublets", "UterineEpithelium", "Pericytes", "B-cells")
length(newIDs)
names(newIDs) <- levels(COL3351A5)
COL3351A5 <- RenameIdents(COL3351A5, newIDs)
COL3351A5_umap_annotated <- DimPlot(COL3351A5, reduction = "umap", label = T, pt.size = 0.5, label.size = 3, repel = T) + NoLegend()
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/COL3351A5_UMAP_Annotated.pdf", plot = COL3351A5_umap_annotated, width = 10, height = 7)
DimPlot(COL3351A5, reduction = "umap", label = T, pt.size = 0.5, label.size = 3) + NoLegend()
```
# Excluding doublets
### Removing all doublets under DF 5% and entire cluster 20 (doublets)
```{r}
to_be_removed <- rownames(COL3351A5@meta.data %>% dplyr::filter(DF.classifications_0.05 == "Doublet"))
length(to_be_removed)
COL3351A5 <- subset(COL3351A5, cells = to_be_removed, invert = T)
COL3351A5 <- subset(COL3351A5, idents = "Doublets", invert = T)
COL3351A5
```
### I will not be removing any other putative doublets, but will save a suspicious cluster to identify them later on
```{r}
susp_cells <- rownames(COL3351A5@meta.data %>% filter(seurat_clusters == 7))
length(susp_cells)
saveRDS(object = susp_cells, file = "Data/COL3351A5_filt_SuspCells1.rds")

susp_cells <- rownames(COL3351A5@meta.data %>% filter(seurat_clusters == 13))
length(susp_cells)
saveRDS(object = susp_cells, file = "Data/COL3351A5_filt_SuspCells2.rds")

susp_cells <- rownames(COL3351A5@meta.data %>% filter(seurat_clusters == 15))
length(susp_cells)
saveRDS(object = susp_cells, file = "Data/COL3351A5_filt_SuspCells3.rds")
```
## Saving the final matrix for future analysis
```{r}
matrix_to_be_saved <- COL3351A5@assays$RNA@counts
head(matrix_to_be_saved)
dim(matrix_to_be_saved)
saveRDS(object = matrix_to_be_saved, file = "Data/COL3351A5_filt_RawCountsMatrix_DPv2.0.rds")
meta <- COL3351A5@meta.data
write.table(x = meta, file = "Data/COL3351A5_filt_Metadata_DPv2.0.txt", quote = F, sep = "\t")
```
